raise_ServiceError: raise a ServiceError to signal a generic service-level failure in your application
raise_SessionNotFound: raise a SessionNotFound error when a requested session ID is not found in the service
raise_ServiceOSError: raise a ServiceOSError to signal a system-level error originating from the service
raise_ServiceInitError: raise a ServiceInitError when the service fails to initialize properly
raise_ServiceTransportError: raise a ServiceTransportError when communication with the service fails
